text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: If you'd like, would you take it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, no,
Trainer went to all the trouble to—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, not at all!
That's not true, if anything...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, I'll gladly take you up on your offer!
Hehe, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then please let me thank you!
There's a cafe nearby that I really recommend!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The fruit juice from that stall is so delicious!
How about we get some?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! All right, let's go~!
